description: A PHP class implementing a generic list data structure for Drupal's TypedData API, supporting list operations, iteration, and data management.

classes.name: ItemList
classes.description: A generic list class for managing collections of TypedData items, supporting list operations, iteration, and change notifications.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an array of the values of all items in the list.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the list items from an array of values, supporting reusing existing items and notifying parent of changes.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of item representations, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a specific numeric index.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of an item at a specific index, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item at a specified index and rekeys the list.

methods.name: rekey
methods.description: Reindexes the list to maintain sequential numeric keys starting from a given index.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first item in the list.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if an offset exists in the list.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes an item at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets an item at a given offset, appending if offset is not set.

methods.name: appendItem
methods.description: Creates and appends a new item to the list.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Helper method to create a new list item instance.

methods.name: getItemDefinition
methods.description: Returns the item definition for the list items.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list items.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters list items based on a callback function.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Notifies parent of changes to the list.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the list and its items.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last item in the list.
